subject: CyberAlchemy Lab research tower foundation, interactive explorer, and white-tower frontier
project_scope: projects/cyberalchemy-lab plus the Research Tower integration in projects/ide-extension
why_now: The Lab foundation, synthetic L0 evidence navigator, local interactive Research Tower explorer, concept assets, and the next white-tower design are being committed together as one coherent local project boundary.
key_points: The Tower Evidence Navigator is implemented as a candidate-local synthetic contract fixture with authority_effect none; it is not a representative corpus, canonical ontology, or promotion source.
The ide-extension exposes a read-only local Research Tower route and API over one locked synthetic witness, with three evidence scenes and a separately namespaced unavailable Tower System reference.
The current committed interface is the tested scenic canvas prototype; the later White Tower View is a reviewed non-executed design and seven-unit work pack, not current product behavior.
The exact next implementation unit is SWU-WT-001: harden manifest truth invariants before changing the visual shell.

The repository contains local concept images and a robot sprite sheet as design exploration; the White Tower plan removes those images from the primary composition and introduces no game or animation-engine dependency.

open_calls.question: Authorize or decline the seven-unit White Tower View implementation work pack beginning with SWU-WT-001.
Select and bind a representative real Research Tower, or explicitly retain the synthetic fixture as mechanics-only.

boundaries: Do not treat the synthetic fixture, its passing validators, or the browser prototype as corpus representativeness, ontology authority, promotion, publication, deployment, release, or production evidence.
Keep the three evidence floors structurally distinct from the five Tower System architecture descriptors; unavailable descriptors remain explanation-only and perform no domain mutation.
Do not add an animation or game engine unless a separately named requirement cannot be met with the existing DOM, CSS, and local JavaScript surface.
Do not cross private Lab evidence into public Arcanum artifacts without a separate scrub and owner decision.

next_actions.owner: Future Goal or Task Session owner
next_actions.action: If separately authorized, execute only SWU-WT-001 against the witness loader and focused Node test, validate it, and stop at that unit boundary.
Review the White Tower View result and decide whether the current scenic prototype should be replaced by the planned white architectural tower.
